title: OECD: Steel Imports to Latin America Up 47%, Mill Capacity Utilization at 60%
dek: OECD data show steel imports to Latin America up 47% and mill capacity utilisation at 60%, according to Metallurgprom.
summary: Metallurgprom reports, citing the OECD, that steel imports to Latin America rose 47% and that mill capacity utilisation stands at 60%. The publisher's excerpt does not specify the period or the sources of imports.
keyFacts: Steel imports to Latin America up 47%
whyItMatters: A sharp rise in imports alongside low utilisation suggests regional mills are under strain, which often precedes trade-defence measures.
implications: Exporters to Latin America could face a greater risk of anti-dumping or safeguard action; readers should watch for policy responses.
